preview: This episode looks at an English-word gacha that brings a card game into vocabulary study. What can this game show us about how people learn words, and what can’t it tell us?
comment_1: As you listen, notice what the gacha makes the learner look for first.
comment_2: So far, rare words have seemed more exciting than useful everyday words. What happens when a rare card gives you a reason to keep opening packs?
comment_3: So far, the game can shift your attention from learning words to chasing rare cards. A rare word is not always the one to study first. As you listen next, notice how the story handles that difference.
comment_4: The gacha can shift your attention from learning words to chasing rare cards. Now let’s bring the story’s main idea together.
